info.title: COLD START
info.author: etonedemid
info.details: COLD START is a roguelike topdown survival with bombs, upgrades, parrying and a console where you can spawn a car and run enemies over. Runs on PC, Nintendo Switch and Wii U homebrew, and Android.

changelog:
v3.6.0
Highlights
- Map editor overhaul: SetVariable / LoadMap triggers are now visible and configurable, Space+drag panning, fit-to-map on open, readable labels when zoomed out, double-click to open maps, working panel close buttons, and an unsaved-changes warning on exit.
- Missing files warning: the game now tells you (system dialog at startup, popup in-game) if any game files failed to load.
- Workshop moved to a new host- with a new signing key. Mods approved from now on need 3.6.0 to install.

 Fixes
- Crash when inspecting Bomber / Spitter / Warden spawns in the editor
- Trigger settings (variable conditions, multi-fire, set-var, load-map) no longer jump to the wrong trigger after deleting one, and are now covered by undo
- Trigger settings were lost on save for maps without cutscenes
- Map Properties player settings (abilities, HP, bombs, speed, damage) now actually apply and save
- A broken map file no longer wipes the map you had open
- Text like "°" renders correctly; long text in fields is cropped instead of squashed
- Editor playtest: pause/death menus say "Back to Editor", and Retry really retries
- Custom map list no longer selects maps just by hovering
- Placeholder sprites for med-relay, power, water and antenna (Kenney, CC0), plus spitter and warden

 ⚠ Android
This APK is signed with a new key. If you have 3.5.1 or older installed, uninstall it first, otherwise Android will refuse the update.

v3.4.0
Cold Start 3.4.0 - a big feature release.

Highlights
- Endless mode: a storage-free, seeded infinite world (set Endless + Seed in the Play menu)
- Giant maze buildings, chained-room buildings, tiled-floor rooms
- New enemies: Bomber (suicide rusher), Spitter (acid spread), Warden (armored tank) - placeable in the editor
- Telegraphed bombings: static barrages and AVI plane flyovers that crater and scorch terrain
- Tactical/military in-game HUD, heavier damage-impact feedback, off-screen enemy arrows
- Combo system + game-feel juice, reworked car physics, player-centered minimap for huge maps, maps up to 1000 tiles
- Fixes: stuck soft-keyboard breaking parry/weapon-switch, numeric input fields, supply-crate spawn distance, softer gunfire

Downloads: Windows, Linux, Switch (NRO), Android (APK), Wii U (WUHB).

v3.3.1
Cold Start 3.3.1

- Wii U: ENet networking ported (online/LAN multiplayer).
- Android: on-screen controls baked to textures (big framerate win).
- Dialog: gamepad choice navigation; choices can branch on a variable.
- Fix: enemies and upgrade boxes no longer spawn inside collision zones.
- PC: GLES2 renderer + batching on Linux; smaller/translucent gamepad crosshairs.
